method: Built-in image_gen only. Three base generations, three initial edit generations, one targeted produce repair. Six final photo files.
coordinate_system: Percent of full 1536x1024 image. x and y are centers. width and height are FULL extents, not radii. object contains the tighter changed-object bounds; top-level extents match suggested mask. featherStart 0.8 means fully opaque through 80 percent of elliptical radius, then fade to zero.
mask_notes: Default suggested mask dimensions are 1.8 times the tight rectangular object bounds; the opaque core contains the tight-box corners. Bakery sugar mask is custom-tightened as requested by the integrator. Derive minimum 44px touch targets independently.

base.name: produce
base.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: base photograph for a challenging spot-the-difference web game, level 1.
Primary request: One highly realistic photograph of a detailed produce display in a Thai wholesale supermarket. Landscape 3:2 aspect ratio, requested 1536 by 1024 pixels. It must look like a professional actual camera photograph, not an illustration.
Scene: eye-level slightly downward view of several tiered produce bins, showing the complete display without giant foreground objects. Dense but well-composed fresh vegetables and fruit in green and black crates: bunches of bananas toward upper left, cabbages and leafy greens across the back, red and yellow bell peppers near middle, tomatoes in the lower left, eggplants near middle right, limes in a lower middle bin, oranges toward lower right. Small red price card holders and red store fixtures add wholesale-store context. Include natural individual variations in produce, believable stacking, plastic crate vents, moisture sheen and real organic texture.
Composition: a realistic 35mm retail photograph with deep focus and sharp detail across the display. Several clearly separated individual produce items visible at roughly 6–10 percent of image width; avoid microscopic clutter. The scene fills the single image, no panels.
Lighting: natural neutral fluorescent supermarket light, realistic soft shadows, restrained saturation.
Constraints: no people, no invented brands, no readable words or numbers anywhere (price cards may be plain cream or red), no logos, no slogans, no UI, no circles, no arrows, no borders, no frames, no grids, no comparison collage. Never include the Thai tagline คู่คิดธุรกิจคุณ. No cartoon, vector, plastic toy, videogame, CGI or render appearance.

base.name: bakery
base.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: base photograph for a challenging spot-the-difference web game, level 2.
Primary request: One highly realistic photograph of a bakery counter and bread display inside a Thai wholesale supermarket. Landscape 3:2 aspect ratio, requested 1536 by 1024 pixels. It must look like an actual photograph from a professional camera, not an illustration.
Scene: straight-on, slightly downward view of a richly detailed bakery display. A wooden and dark metal display with two rear shelf levels and a foreground counter. Real crusty breads in baskets, a baguette basket at upper left, round sourdough loaves and rolls on a back shelf, small pastries and croissants across the mid shelf, a tray of muffins toward right, foreground trays with spiral pastries, sesame buns and a few fruit danishes. Retail bakery paper liners and one small pair of metal serving tongs. Subtle red retail accents in card holders or shelf trim. Small price cards have no readable text.
Composition: dense, natural believable bakery arrangement, complete single scene. Deep focus; all breads and pastries sharply detailed and textured. No objects cut off in a confusing way. Several individual pastry details sized roughly 5–9 percent of image width and distributed throughout the image, suitable for five subtle localized edits later.
Lighting: realistic warm-neutral shop lighting, natural shadows, honest golden bread colors, no theatrical lighting.
Constraints: no people, no brands, no readable words or numbers, no logos, no slogans, no UI, markers, circles, arrows, borders, grids or collage. Never include the Thai tagline คู่คิดธุรกิจคุณ. Not cartoon, illustration, toy, videogame, CGI or 3D render.

base.name: grocery
base.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: base photograph for a challenging spot-the-difference web game, level 3.
Primary request: One highly realistic photograph of dense condiment and grocery shelves in a Thai wholesale supermarket. Landscape 3:2 aspect ratio, requested 1536 by 1024 pixels. It must look like a real camera photograph, not an illustration.
Scene: close straight-on view of a supermarket shelving bay, three main shelf rows with a dense yet orderly assortment of realistic cooking ingredients. Upper shelf: soy sauce and cooking oil bottles with caps, spice jars, and small tins. Middle shelf: chili sauce bottles, jars of pickles, curry pastes in jars, and stacks of plain cans. Bottom shelf: condiments in squat jars, seasoning packets and bottled sauces. Different real glass, PET plastic, metal and paper materials. Bottle and jar shapes, cap colors, simple solid-color blank label blocks create believable anonymous retail packaging, with no legible lettering. Subtle red horizontal trim on shelf edge conveys a wholesale supermarket. Natural slightly imperfect product facing and varied inventory counts.
Composition: camera square to the shelf, only mild natural perspective, deep focus with every product crisp. Products fill the single scene. Approximately 10–14 distinct facings per row, giving many rich repeated details but individual bottles and jars remain about 5–9 percent of image width, phone-readable. Keep shelves horizontal and composition clean.
Lighting: realistic neutral fluorescent store light, authentic reflections and contact shadows, natural colors.
Constraints: no people, no invented brands, no readable words or numbers, no logos, no slogans, no UI, markers, circles, arrows, borders, grids or collage. Never include the Thai tagline คู่คิดธุรกิจคุณ. No cartoon, illustration, plastic toy, videogame, CGI or render appearance.

initial_edits.name: produce
initial_edits.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: edited photograph for a five-difference game.
Input image 1 is the exact EDIT TARGET, not just a style reference. Return one edited 1536×1024 landscape photograph with exactly the same registration and framing. Change ONLY the following FIVE small localized details, with coordinates measured from the top left in the 1536×1024 input:
1. In the front-facing banana bunch at upper left, the small pair of upright yellow bananas around x=180,y=190: add several clearly visible natural dark-brown ripening patches to their yellow peel. Restrict this edit to approximately x=141–238,y=132–255. Do not alter the other bananas.
2. The frontmost round pale-green cabbage at x=611,y=215, just above the red peppers: change only this cabbage into a purple/red cabbage, preserving its exact outline, size, leaf folds and shadows. Restrict to x=548–679,y=163–265.
3. The single front yellow bell pepper with a green stem centered at x=875,y=393, directly above the green-pepper crate: change that pepper's yellow skin to natural red while preserving the stem, shape and specular highlights. Restrict to x=832–925,y=354–426.
4. The uppermost prominent red tomato with its small green calyx centered at x=368,y=724 in the lower-left tomato bin: make its skin yellow-gold, keeping contour, calyx, position and highlights identical. Restrict to x=327–410,y=682–766.
5. Remove only the foreground orange centered at x=1068,y=787 in the orange bin. Show the plausible orange behind it and a small natural shaded gap, without moving neighboring fruit. Restrict to x=1018–1126,y=734–846.
Pixel-preservation constraints: preserve every other vegetable, fruit, crate, price card, store fixture, background, camera angle, crop, depth of field, texture, color balance, light and shadow. No global regeneration, zoom, shift, lighting or exposure changes. Keep the exact positions and shapes of unchanged objects. All five regions must match and blend seamlessly with the unchanged original photograph.
No new text, branding, circles, arrows, markings, UI, border or collage. Do not include the phrase คู่คิดธุรกิจคุณ. Output is a single photorealistic edited photograph.

runtime_notes: Original PNG outputs are encoded as 1536x1024 WebP at quality 88. Both panels use the same original. An edited layer is visible only inside five elliptical CSS masks, with a fully opaque 76% core and feathered edge. See levels.js for the authoritative runtime coordinates and touch target sizes.
